name: Site Migration
description: Move a WordPress site to Slate: pages and posts (block editor content as clean HTML, Elementor and other builder pages kept exactly as designed and editable by clicking), custom post types, taxonomies and ACF fields, media, menus, forms, templates, comments, authors, SEO from Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO and SEOPress, and redirects. Reads the live site, an export file, a database dump or an uploads archive; keeps old links, asset URLs and form endpoints working.
author: Slate

changelog.2.0.0: Five-step wizard (Connect, Analyse, Choose, Import, Report) with a per-category analysis and report. New sources: optional Slate Export companion plugin, database dump (read, never run) and uploads archive. Exact ACF field groups (repeater, group, flexible content, relationships, galleries, choices) and CPT UI / ACF post types; builder pages as designed pages; Gutenberg to clean HTML; forms from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms and Elementor; Elementor Theme Builder and block templates as Slate templates; comments; authors; global SEO settings and plugin redirects; live post lists. Network access limited to the source site. Existing migrations sync exactly as before unless the new options are chosen.
